3967-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

1981-2034-2415-4476.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2034-2415-4476.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

277-1308-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2364-4574-4659-6769-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
2364-4574-4659-6769-6842.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
When Mana Vault enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mana Vault, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mana Vault from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mana Vault.
Repeat.

1174-1257-7857.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
1174-1257-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer  triggers, untapping Walking Atlas.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

1563-1849-2457-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

489-4200-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5086-5183-6753-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4050-5086-5183-6753-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

252-2440-4720-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it. It will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
When the Improvised Arsenal token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Dinosaur you control.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
252-2440-4720-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more Dinosaurs as the combo begins. You should perform step 3 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool.

546-4613-5900-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in all graveyards.
546-4613-5900-7231.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Drakestown Forgotten. Drakestown Forgotten enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Drakestown Forgotten using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

628-3967-7200.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-1753-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-2557-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2893-3875-4500-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-4289-6791-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-6791-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2173-2292-5220-5931.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1632-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Stonespeaker Crystal's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

765-1479-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-6528.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

64-1018-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1018-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Warden of the Eye.
When Skullwinder and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1018-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2760-4279-5104.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
2760-4279-5104.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature token
When the creature token dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

348-394-2178-2577.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-394-2178-2577.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

509-549-1267-3933.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-549-1267-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-549-1267-3933.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

354-3525-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
354-3525-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Lifecraft Awakening by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gilded Lotus and causing it to become a 0/0 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying {1}{U}{U}, attaching it to Gilded Lotus.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

1744-2560-3149-3994.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting Precursor Golem.
Precursor Golem's second ability triggers, creating a kicked copy of Rite of Replication targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Rite of Replication, creating five token copies of the Golem it is targeting.
If the Golem was Percursor Golem, the Percursor Golem tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their first abilities, creating a total of ten 3/3 Golem artifact creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 for each other Rite of Replication.
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any Golem.
The six Percursor Golems' second abilities each trigger, creating six copies of Chandra's Ignition targeting every other Golem.
Resolve the first Chandra's Ignition, causing the Golem to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Chandra's Ignition.

2580-3263-4376.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield, Lethal Vapors triggers, destroying that creature.
Because Damping Matrix prevents Lethal Vapors's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

1506-2178-3496.notablePrerequisites:
Burrning Anger in hand.Thornbite Staff attached to Dread Slaver.
A player controls a nontoken creature with toughness less than or equal to Dread Slaver's power.
1506-2178-3496.description:
Cast Burning Anger by paying {4}{R}, targeting Dread Slaver.
Activate Dread Slaver by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any creature with toughness less than or equal to Dread Slaver's power.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Dread Slaver triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Dread Slaver.
Resolve the second trigger, returning the creature to the battlefield from its owner's graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

1765-2279-2287-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1765-2279-2287-4050.description:
Cast Fiery Mantle by paying {1}{R}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Fiery Mantle enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit and the creature that Fiery Mantle is attached to, adding {1}{R}.
Fiery Mantle triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.

1732-2104-2971-3662-3904.notablePrerequisites: Initiate's Companion does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1732-2104-2971-3662-3904.description:
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Late to Dinner from your graveyard.
Declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first Finest Hour trigger, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Finest Hour trigger, untapping Initiate's Companion and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
Move to your second combat phase, and declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted ability triggers, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Late to Dinner and Temporal Manipulation from exile without paying their mana costs.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Late to Dinner, returning Izzet Chemister from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Food token.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

147-4050-4558-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
147-4050-4558-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Extus triggers, returning either Dualcaster Mage or any other nonlegendary creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, targeting Brass's Bounty.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, creating a copy of Brass's Bounty.
Extus triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
